Dataset Card for VocSim - Avian Perception Alignment
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset is used in the VocSim benchmark paper, specifically designed to evaluate how well neural audio embeddings align with biological perceptual judgments of similarity. It utilizes data from Zandberg et al.
